description: When check_request shows stage trial (or trial_ended), keeping the API costs $3 and comes back as $3 of usage credit on it; it becomes permanent and public, and your trial key keeps working. Free with a monthly plan build. With a key this pays from its credit (or uses a plan build). Without a key, POST the authorize_url from check_request and pay the 402 with an x402 client (held up to 30 minutes, settled only if built).

api_key.description: Any of your keys (its credit or your account balance pays; plan builds are used first).

name: authorize_build
title: Keep a trial API
